comment: The six switches are sent to the RKD at src/BRK.cpp:54-77, once for an RKD on the left and once for one on the right, with the left-hand case tested first so it wins. The two Max Div switches are deliberately crossed on the way out (:59-60): the switch the code calls SWITCH_MAXDIVRANGE32 drives the RKD's Max Div 16 jumper and vice versa, which compensates for the two being drawn in the opposite order (:128-130) from the jumpers' left-to-right order on the RKD board. The result on the panel is what the printing says, and it matches the manual: both switches left gives 64, both right gives 8. The parameter tooltips do not: the switch tooltipped Max Div 16 is the one the panel marks 32 on the left, and the switch tooltipped Max Div 32 is the one marked 16. Because the RKD's parameters are written every sample from here, moving a jumper on the RKD itself has no lasting effect while a BRK is attached.
